name: reachstream-email-verifier
description: Verify email addresses with your ReachStream EmailVerifier account.

interface.longDescription:
ReachStream EmailVerifier checks whether email addresses are real and safe to send to, right inside ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to verify one address or a short list, and it shows each address's status: Valid, Catch-All, Risky or Invalid.

Who it's for: sales, marketing and recruiting teams who want to clean their contacts before outreach, without leaving the conversation.

How it works: connect once by signing in with your ReachStream EmailVerifier account. ChatGPT sends the addresses to ReachStream, waits for the check to finish, and shows the results. You can also ask for the results of an earlier request by its request ID.

What you need: a ReachStream EmailVerifier account. You can create one at emailverifier.reachstream.com.

Limitations: EmailVerifier only checks addresses you give it. It does not find new email addresses and does not send emails. A result reflects the address at the time of the check and does not guarantee delivery. Most checks finish within seconds; larger lists take longer.
defaultPrompt: Verify whether name@company.com is a valid email address.
Check these emails before my campaign: anna@company.com, raj@company.com
Is this email address safe to send to?

positive.expected_behavior: Submits the address, checks the request until it is completed, and shows the status Valid with the request ID. One credit is used.

positive.description: Verify several addresses in one go
positive.prompt: Check whether these emails are valid: fida.sarosh+openai@insnap.in, nobody@example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Submits both addresses in one request and shows a status for each: fida.sarosh+openai@insnap.in Valid, nobody@example.com Invalid.

positive.description: Flag an address that cannot receive email
positive.prompt: Is nobody@example.com a real email address I can send to?
positive.expected_behavior: Verifies the address, shows the status Invalid, and advises not to send to it.

positive.prompt: Show me the result of my email verification request 385451.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches that request and shows its status, progress and the result for each address, without creating a new verification.

positive.prompt: Get the results of my verification requests 385451 and 385452.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches both requests in one call and shows the results of each, without creating a new verification.

negative.description: Finding new email addresses is not supported
negative.prompt: Find the email address of the CEO of Microsoft.

negative.description: Writing or sending emails is not supported
negative.prompt: Write and send a cold outreach email to a marketing manager.

negative.description: Deleting verification history is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete all my past email verification requests.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Verifications use credits from the user's existing ReachStream EmailVerifier account.

publication.release_notes: First release: verify one or more email addresses and look up verification results with your ReachStream EmailVerifier account.
